{{Quote|There is a region of space beyond the Outer Rim called the Long Shadow. There are no stars, no light, no life.... Just a derelict starship drifting into a massive black hole. My fortune waits for you there. [&hellip;] Few spacers have seen the Long Shadow and survived. They describe it as a vast darkness, slowly consuming the galaxy.|[[Nok Drayen]]|<ref name="TOR1">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|The Frozen Demon|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
'''The Long Shadow''' was a lifeless region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] at the farthest edge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in the distant [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], home to only a supermassive [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] rumored by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] that had seen it to be slowly consuming the galaxy. Navigating the Long Shadow required a special [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]], [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] [[Ray shield/Legends|shielding]]. It held a derelict [[Starship/Legends|ship]] containing the treasure of [[Nok Drayen]].<ref name="TOR1" /> After acquiring the necessary components, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] that would become known as [[Voidhound|the Voidhound]] traveled to the Long Shadow to acquire the treasure before the black hole consumed the ship.<ref name="TOR2">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|The Endless Abyss|a derelict vessel}}</ref>
